Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great to learn more about Acme's plans to embed search and summarization into your customer support portal. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Requirements we captured: ~50k monthly active users, peak concurrent inference ~250 qps across shorter chat queries (avg seq len ~120) and longer summarization jobs (avg seq len ~1,200).
- Key SLOs: 95th percentile latency <= 350ms for chat; throughput for batch summarization of ~20k docs nightly.
- Compliance: you noted SOC 2 and a vendor security questionnaire.

Next step: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing + technical deep dive with our solutions engineering team to map workload to an optimal Dedicated configuration (GPU types, batching, KV cache strategy) and to walk through the sizing template. Camila (cc'd) will run the session. Can you confirm availability for a 60-minute session? Proposed slots (PST):

- Thu Mar 11, 10:00-11:00am
- Thu Mar 11, 3:00-4:00pm
- Fri Mar 12, 9:00-10:00am

I've attached a short sizing template you can pre-fill (Redwood_Dedicated_Sizing_Template.xlsx) — if you can share the doc prior to the call we can come prepared with a draft config. Also attaching the security questionnaire you asked about.

If none of these times work, happy to share a calendar link to pick something.

Thanks,
